tokens.name: saffron
tokens.usage: Primary accent. Hero and Recommendations blocks, service cards, availability dot, core-stack chips, labels and the contact address on dark blocks, buttons on dark blocks. Text on it is navy.

tokens.name: coral
tokens.usage: Secondary accent. Quote and How I work blocks, service cards. Text on it is navy.

tokens.name: teal
tokens.usage: Deep block. Selected work and Contact blocks, service cards. Text on it is mint.

tokens.name: mint
tokens.usage: Page ground and light text. Default background, cards on dark blocks, text on teal and navy.

tokens.name: navy
tokens.usage: Ink. All body text on light blocks, outlines, primary buttons, Facts, Stack and footer blocks.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Recommendation cards only.
